title: tag-inline-toc annotation
description: Phase-1 output: an ordered list of sa bcad sections. The model emits this; tag_inline_toc.py assigns block IDs and renders. No block IDs appear here — they are derived from depth. A section is anchored by body_start_line (a 1-based line number) or body_start_context (a unique verbatim substring), or both; at least one is required.

source_file.description: Optional. Path of the input file this annotation describes.

sections.description: Sections in DOCUMENT ORDER, top to bottom. Depth must descend one level at a time (no skipped levels).

depth.description: Nesting depth. 1 = top-level (## heading). Each step deeper adds one to the block-ID path.

heading_title.description: Short section name for the heading line — the announced term only, NOT the full ordinal phrase (e.g. 'བཤད་པ།' not 'གཉིས་པ་བཤད་པ།').

body_start_line.description: 1-based line number in the ORIGINAL text where this section's body begins. The heading line is inserted immediately before it. Preferred over body_start_context: a position cannot be ambiguous, and on Tibetan commentary a body opener such as 'དང་པོ་ནི།' recurs dozens of times with no unique substring available.

body_start_context.description: A verbatim substring from the ORIGINAL text that is unique to the line where this section's body paragraph begins. Make it long enough to be unique. When given alongside body_start_line it is checked against that line, catching an annotation written against an older revision.

restatement.description: Optional. The verbatim ordinal+title phrase at the start of the body (e.g. 'གཉིས་པ་བཤད་པ་') to wrap in a self-referential wikilink. Must occur on the body-start line.

announced_in_parent.description: Optional. Where this section is named inside the PARENT's enumeration sentence. The term is wrapped in a forward link to this section's id. Anchored by line or context, same rule as the section itself.

line.description: 1-based line number of the parent's enumeration line.

context.description: A verbatim substring unique to the parent's enumeration line.

term.description: The verbatim announced term within that line to wrap (minimal structural term only — no particles or count words).
